product_metadata.title: SUPERIOR Ultra-Plush Fleece Blankets, Thick, Cozy, and Warm Premium Quality Fleece, Velvety Soft Bed Blankets and Throws - 106" x 90" King Blanket, White
features: PERFECT FLEECE BLANKET. These ultra soft fleece blankets and throws provide cozy warmth and snug comfort year-round, as a cozy addition to your bed, or the perfect throw blanket for the sofa. The premium quality fleece is remarkably plush, feeling thick and cozy while still lightweight and breathable for year-round use. They make an easy and thoughtful housewarming, birthday, wedding, or holiday gift

PREMIUM CONSTRUCTION. This King blanket measures 106” x 90”, and is made of high quality 100% micro Polyester fleece. The 320 GSM weight is great for layering in colder weather or can be used on its own for chilly summer nights. The tightly knitted base is strong and durable, and the plush fleece is brushed and sheared on both sides for an indulgently soft feel

DRAPE TO STYLE. This gorgeous blanket has a lustrous, velvety sheen and is available in 12 solid colors to suit any room’s décor. Add a neutral color blanket to tie the room together or choose a bolder option to add a pop of color. Perfect for a master bedroom, guest room, or kid’s room, on the couch or sofa, for your furry pets to cuddle and snuggle, or to use in the backyard, porch, or patio on chilly evenings and at family gatherings

EFFORTLESS CARE. Our anti-pill fleece is free of wrinkles and is machine washable for easy care. Please allow few hours after removal from packaging for item to attain its full plushness. Do not bleach, dry clean or Iron to maintain the color, soft feel, and strength of the fabric. Always follow care label instructions for best results.

GUARANTEE: PLEASE CHECK “SOLD BY” SELLER NAME. Only Superior products sold by Amazon.com or Prime sellers are guaranteed genuine. Upon receipt, please confirm that your product says Superior on the care label as well as HOME CITY INC as the manufacturer. If it doesn't say Superior, please contact Amazon and us immediately
description: Superior is excited to present our velvety soft, extra fluffy all-season fleece blanket. Made of 100% premium micro polyester, this versatile blanket is light enough to use in spring, fall or summer and perfect for layering on cold nights. The ultra-soft plush fleece is brushed and sheared on both sides to give it an amazingly soft feel, a luxe velvety sheen and a delicate silky touch for luxurious and cozy comfort. These stunning blankets and throws can be draped over the back or armrest of a sofa, or at the end of the bed when not in use for a classic, sophisticated look. Available in a variety of 12 different solid colors from neutral to bright, these fleece blankets make the perfect elegant accent to your bedroom or living space. Choose from black, blue, chocolate brown, charcoal grey, coral, evergreen, ivory, navy blue, red, silver, turquoise, and white to enrich your home’s décor, or to gift to family, friends, and colleagues.  This blanket with is available in four popular sizes; king bed, full/queen bed, twin bed, and throw size to accommodate any space. The premium quality fleece fabric is wrinkle and fade resistant, anti-pill and anti-static, and light weight and breathable. The edges are finely stitched to give it a neat finish and lasting durability. Always follow care label instructions for best results.

We have been manufacturing fine linens for over 40 years. We make everything from sheets, duvets, pillowcases, and bedskirts, to towels and bath robes, comforters and mattress toppers, and even area rugs. Our wide range of colors, patterns, and price points ensures that every one of our customers will be able to find something they'll love. We are experts in manufacturing high quality textiles and pride ourselves on only producing the finest products.
